original.statement: The metric cilium_node_connectivity_status is deprecated in favour of cilium_node_health_connectivity_status.

corrected.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric cilium_node_connectivity_status is deprecated in favour of cilium_node_health_connectivity_status.

decision.reason: [ev-82ab63ec4bf8] says `cilium_node_connectivity_status` is now deprecated, with `cilium_node_health_connectivity_status` as its replacement, so the change type and replacement are right. The proposed subject breaks the identity rules in two ways. Protocol-behavior names are free-form, so they must be lowercase kebab-case, but the proposal kept underscores. It also puts the product in a field, which the rules forbid. No subject family covers metrics, so protocol-behavior is only the closest fit, which is why confidence is low.
